verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a GenAI DDQ feature with autofill for questionnaires and the ability to upload previous questionnaires to a library, so some questionnaire ingestion exists. Nothing shows which formats it handles or whether completed questionnaires go back out in the customer's original format. missing for 10: SIG/CAIQ format support, portal questionnaire handling, spreadsheet import of incoming questionnaires, export in the customer's original format, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent
